title: platanus × acerifolia var. suttneri
intro: Platanus × acerifolia var. suttneri, commonly known as Suttner's London Planetree, is a variant of the London Planetree (Platanus × acerifolia), a hybrid plant species derived from the American and Oriental plane trees (Platanus occidentalis and Platanus orientalis). The health benefits of Suttner's London Planetree include its potential to alleviate symptoms of allergies and respiratory issues due to its pollen-reducing properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and support wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Suttner's London Planetree include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
